meta.description: SOP §3 — sends the background-check request email (3 character references + employment verification contacts). Triggered by POST /webhook/onb-bg-check-initiate with { onboarderId, template, event, context: { full_name, first_name, personal_email, role_title, onboarding_lead } }. After import, replace `REPLACE_ME` Gmail credential ID with the linked Gmail account (recommended: onboarding@romega-solutions.com), then activate. Env: N8N_BG_CHECK_INITIATE_URL.
